verdict.rationale: Windmill documents versioning through Git sync, which commits every deploy and can auto-deploy commits from the repo. Flows carry numeric version IDs that webhooks can pin to, and a Compare & Deploy page lets you review AI-edited items before deploying. Rollback is never documented as a feature; it is only implied by git-driven deploys and pinnable versions. Missing for 10: an explicit documented rollback/revert-to-previous-version capability, review details beyond the AI-edit flow (diffs/approvals), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Each time an item is deployed, Windmill will create and push a commit to the specified repository.
Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID instead of the latest deployment.
ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
